summary: The requirement document asks for an online loan application platform for Sahyog Finance, a lender of small business loans. Applicants apply on the web or in an Android and iOS app, verify identity, upload documents and sign online, while the credit team scores, reviews and approves each application. The existing loan accounting system stays as it is, and the vendor supports the platform for three years.
